key.name: layout-mode
key.description: arc or vertical

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where the carousel appears: left, right, or bottom

key.name: thumbnail-size
key.description: Size of thumbnails as percentage of base size

key.name: angle-step
key.description: Degrees between carousel items (smaller = more items visible)

key.name: scroll-speed
key.description: Carousel scroll speed (1 = slowest, 20 = fastest)

key.name: hide-delay
key.description: Milliseconds before panel hides after mouse leaves

key.name: persistent-mode
key.description: Keep panel visible when the screen edge area is clear of windows

key.name: vert-spacing
key.description: Spacing in pixels between thumbnails in vertical layout mode

key.name: multi-monitor-mode
key.description: single = one panel controls all monitors, separate = each monitor has its own panel

key.name: order-map
key.description: JSON map of group_key to display order index

key.name: merge-map
key.description: JSON map of app_id to group_key for merged groups

key.name: show-close-button
key.description: Show close button on thumbnail cards on hover

key.name: show-app-label
key.description: Show application name label below thumbnails

key.name: show-panel-background
key.description: Show semi-transparent background behind the panel

key.name: highlight-active
key.description: Highlight the currently focused app with a border

key.name: close-button-position
key.description: Position of close button on cards: left or right

key.name: max-recent-groups
key.description: Maximum number of app groups shown in sidebar

key.name: inactive-tilt
key.description: Y-axis rotation in degrees for inactive cards (0 = flat)

key.name: inactive-scale
key.description: Scale percentage for inactive cards (100 = same as active)

key.name: activate-mode
key.description: raise = bring to front only, focus = bring to front and minimize others

key.name: animation-speed
key.description: Animation duration percentage (50 = fast, 100 = normal, 200 = slow)

key.name: show-window-count
key.description: Show badge with window count on multi-window groups

key.name: show-tooltip
key.description: Show window title tooltip on hover

key.name: panel-margin
key.description: Margin in pixels from the screen edge
